notes.title: Bugfixes #1
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed issues with getting stuck with it being noones turn
[*]Fixed Color selecting, it now auto selects a color when you join
[*]Added indicators to the current player's turn and the upcoming players turn for more strategic tactics
[/list]

Thank you everyone for playing and giving feedback!

notes.title: JOIN OUR OPEN PLAYTEST, SIGNUP OPEN NOW
notes.content:
Starting Now till Sunday we'll be approving everyone for our open playtest of Drop 4.

In addition to the playtest we invite everyone to our discord, here we will be playing with the community. You can find our links below.

notes.title: Changes to how bombs work
notes.content:
I have had some testing and found players have been playing near the top of the board most of the time early on. To combat this I have changed how bombs work so they now explode vertically to start instead of horizontally before and then cause a chain reaction if there's more than one bomb on the same column check out the video below to see: 
https://youtu.be/kO0bvqhkuUQ
